name: House Dedication
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of dedicating our homes to the Lord, recognizing that true security and success come only when God is at the center. As Joshua declared, commitment to serve the Lord extends to the entire household, establishing a foundation of faith. Wisdom and understanding are essential in building and establishing a home, but ultimately, it is the Lord who builds and guards it, making human efforts meaningful. Believers are encouraged to build and dwell in their houses confidently, trusting in God's protection and provision as their refuge and help.
